prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: six distinct STATIC aquatic creature master sprites for a Daoist chibi arcade fish-catching game. This is NOT animation, NOT UI, NOT a collectible card layout.
Input images: Image 1 approved mail UI and Image 2 approved team UI are PRIMARY art-style references only: refined high-definition hand painting, rounded chibi forms, restrained jade/ivory/warm-gold accents, clean delicate outlines, lively warm eyes, soft nuanced shading. Image 3 is the existing fish encyclopedia: inherit its fish species silhouette, brushwork and readable miniature character rendering, NOT its UI frames or background.
Canvas: landscape 3:2 aspect, target 1536x1024 native if available. Organize into EXACTLY THREE equal-width columns and TWO equal-height rows, six equal rectangular invisible cells. Place exactly ONE different creature at the geometric center of each cell. All parts including every tail fin, whisker, arm and tentacle fit completely inside their own cell, leaving at least 15 percent transparent empty margin from EVERY cell boundary. Draw no grid, no labels, no frame, no text. Keep roughly 10 percent of total canvas around the outer edge transparent and large clear transparent gaps between all sprites.
Required row-major species, each exactly once:
1. top-left cell ONLY: friendly jade-green sea turtle with gold cloud-pattern shell. Internal species ID 13-yunwengui, Chinese identity 云纹龟 (these are instructions, DO NOT draw any text).
2. top-center cell ONLY: transparent lavender jellyfish with soft moonlike bell and short flowing tentacles. Internal species ID 14-huanyue, Chinese identity 幻月水母 (these are instructions, DO NOT draw any text).
3. top-right cell ONLY: wide deep blue manta ray, ivory tips and long safe tail. Internal species ID 15-lanray, Chinese identity 蓝鳐 (these are instructions, DO NOT draw any text).
4. bottom-left cell ONLY: orange-red striped lionfish with elaborate striped fins. Internal species ID 16-shiziyu, Chinese identity 狮子鱼 (these are instructions, DO NOT draw any text).
5. bottom-center cell ONLY: pink red compact reef fish with coral-like crest. Internal species ID 17-shanhuyu, Chinese identity 珊瑚鱼 (these are instructions, DO NOT draw any text).
6. bottom-right cell ONLY: long emerald arowana with subtle cloud scales and two whiskers. Internal species ID 18-qinglong, Chinese identity 青龙鱼 (these are instructions, DO NOT draw any text).
Camera and facing: consistent elevated three-quarter side / slightly top-down view. Fish and turtle heads point RIGHT, tails point left. Seahorses and jellyfish remain naturally upright with face or bell to the right where appropriate; octopus and crab naturally centered front-three-quarter with complete limbs. Use distinct natural shapes and faces per species, never recolored duplicates. All six are individual full-body master stills, no motion trails or bubbles, no separate decorative objects.
Finish: premium crisp detailed yet clean chibi hand-painted game art, consistent with references. Bold readable silhouette at planned small game size, soft controlled highlights, restrained gold/jade accents appropriate to each creature. Animals look living and friendly fantasy, not plastic toys, not photorealism or flat icons. Balanced detail and no dense noise.
Transparency: genuine RGBA alpha. Completely empty transparent background. No backdrop, ocean scene, seafloor, colored rectangles, opaque white, painted checkerboard, shadow ellipse, glow clouds, UI panel or card edges. No labels or logos. No creature or appendage may touch another cell or extend beyond its own invisible rectangle.
